segments.name: QHI
products: Student accommodation and other related services
segments.description: Operating subsidiary Quest Holding International LLC, providing study abroad and post-study services for Chinese students in the United States.
segments.evidence: During the year ended September 30, 2025, the Company operated in three primary reportable segments, representing its operating subsidiaries QHI, DC, and DU.

segments.name: DC
products: Student accommodation and other related services
segments.description: Operating subsidiary DavisU Canada Inc., which runs EduGlobal College in Vancouver, British Columbia.
segments.evidence: During the year ended September 30, 2025, the Company operated in three primary reportable segments, representing its operating subsidiaries QHI, DC, and DU.

segments.name: DU
products: Student accommodation and other related services
segments.description: Operating subsidiary running Davis University in Toledo, Ohio, offering academic programs including four-year degrees.
segments.evidence: During the year ended September 30, 2025, the Company operated in three primary reportable segments, representing its operating subsidiaries QHI, DC, and DU.

revenueModel.text: Students pay tuition fees for academic programs, plus accommodation, collaborative education and application and advisory services, partly collected through business partners.
revenueModel.evidence: Receivable from the Company's business partners in China, Beijing Renda Financial Education Technology Co., Ltd. and Wenfeng Shenghe Study Abroad Co. Ltd., represent the student tuition fee collected by them on behalf of DU and DC.

changes.text: In fiscal 2024 DC became a third reportable segment, after fiscal 2023 reported only QHI and DU as reportable segments.
changes.evidence: During the year ended September 30, 2023, the Company operated in two primary reportable segments, representing its operating subsidiaries QHI and DU.
